parse_preflib_data: parse PrefLib SOC or SOI string data and return a PreferenceProfile with alternatives and votes
parse_preflib_datafile: parse a PrefLib SOC or SOI data file from disk and return a PreferenceProfile
create_parse_preflib_data: create a call to parse_preflib_data with PrefLib string data containing alternatives and ranked votes
create_parse_preflib_datafile: create a call to parse_preflib_datafile with a PrefLib file path to load a preference profile
test_parse_preflib_data: test parse_preflib_data with sample PrefLib SOC data containing alternative names and weighted votes
